note: G8 M6, the reviewer's own program. A reference rule fires on the whole line, not on a span of it, so a block that carries two Q words handed both of them to the `M98 Q` rule and the 3 mm (3000 micron) peck depth of the G83 came back as Q30. No control accepts such a block and no post writes one, but the rewrite was silent, and this module's rule is refuse rather than guess. Both words are reported and neither is touched.
